column3: “They were calling” recasts one calling to another.
“Doorposts and thresholds” recasts the foundations of the thresholds; “their voices” is plural where the Hebrew names the one calling.
“Hearts” is plural instead of a singular collective heart; “calloused” and “deafen” replace the images of fatness and heaviness.
“In the land” supplies the referent of “her” in the final phrase.
